infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Terra uses the camera for job photos: the damage walk before you start, progress shots, and the completion photos the office needs to invoice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Terra needs your photo library so you can attach existing job photos and site plans.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Terra saves job photos back to your camera roll so you keep your own copy.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Terra shares your location with the office only while you have a job running, so they can see the crew on the map. It stops when you mark the job complete.
